question.values: Do you notice anything in the values?
question.codes: Explain my fault codes and what I should do now.

failure.key: A valid AI key is missing. Enter it in the settings under “AI copilot”.
failure.quota: The quota or credit is used up. Try again later.
failure.refused: This request was declined. Please rephrase it.

memory.title: What I know about you
memory.note: In dialogue, the conversation remembers a few preferences at most. Everything stays on this device and in your backup; each talk sends at most five fitting notes to the AI provider, and learning sends the answers of the talk and the list.

talk.title: Conversation

notice.needs_key: Chat and quiz need an AI key. Companion, tips, eco and facts about the route work without one.
notice.failed: Not possible right now, I will try again.
notice.no_microphone: No microphone available or not allowed.

talk.quiet: All right, I will be quiet.
talk.question: Quiz question: {{question}} {{options}}
talk.none: No answer recognised. The answer is {{key}}.
talk.usual: Looks like we are off to {{name}} again. Have a good drive!
talk.usual_offer: Are you going to {{name}} again? Shall I start the route?

remark.tank: Your tank is almost empty, about {{range}} left. Plan a stop to refuel.
remark.pause: You have been driving for over two hours. A break would do you good.
remark.cold: The engine is still cold. Lower revs make it last longer.
remark.braking: You have braked hard a few times today. Lifting off earlier saves brake pads and fuel.
remark.accelerating: You are accelerating quite hard today. A gentler start saves fuel.
remark.revs: The engine is often revving high. Shift up a bit earlier, it is quieter and saves fuel.
remark.idling: We have been standing with the engine running for a while. For longer stops it pays to switch it off.
remark.smooth: Nice and smooth so far. A pleasure to ride along.

talk.off: The conversation is switched off in the settings.

tips.cold: The engine is still cold. Keep the revs low for the first few kilometres, it likes that.
tips.brake_early: A few brakings were tight today. A bit more distance makes it more relaxed.
tips.gentle_start: You pull away hard today. A gentler start is quieter and spares tyres and clutch.
tips.pause_soon: You have been driving for an hour and a half. A short break would be good at the next chance.
tips.calmer_than_usual: You drive more calmly than usual today. Keep it up.
tips.busier_than_usual: There is more braking and accelerating than usual today. Maybe allow a little more time?
tips.distance: Rule of thumb for the distance: at least two seconds to the car ahead, more in the wet.
tips.look_ahead: Looking far ahead helps: who sees early what is coming rarely has to brake hard.
tips.phone: The phone can wait. I will tell you if something important comes up.
tips.tyres: Checking the tyre pressure now and then pays off, best once a month at the petrol station.
tips.seat: A well adjusted seat and mirrors make long drives much more pleasant.
tips.lights: In Switzerland, lights are on during the day too. In rain and fog anyway.
tips.wipers: Streaks on the windscreen? Then the wiper blades are probably due soon.
tips.zip: When lanes merge: drive to the end of the lane, then take turns.

eco.score_better: Your eco score is {{score}} today, better than your average of {{usual}}. Well done.
eco.score_worse: Your eco score is {{score}} today, usually you are at {{usual}}. There is room for more.
eco.fuel_better: You use less fuel than usual today. The tank is pleased.
eco.fuel_worse: You need more fuel than usual today. A gentler foot helps.
eco.shift_early: The engine often revs high. Shifting up earlier saves fuel and is quieter.
eco.idle: We have been standing with the engine running for a while. On longer stops it pays to switch it off.
eco.coast: With red ahead, lift off early and let the car roll, that costs almost nothing.
eco.tyre_pressure: Too little air in the tyres costs noticeable fuel. The right pressure is usually on the door.
eco.steady: Driving steadily is the biggest saving: better constant than always throttle and brake.
eco.roof_box: Roof racks or boxes that are not needed cost fuel. Take them off when they are empty.
eco.weight: Needless weight in the boot costs fuel on every drive.
eco.motorway: On the motorway, 110 instead of 120 saves noticeable fuel and hardly any time.
eco.air_con: Air conditioning uses fuel. When it is pleasant outside, the fan is often enough.
eco.short_trips: Short trips with a cold engine use the most. Short ways can often be walked.

brake.0: Phew, that was close. Well reacted.
brake.1: My coffee would not have survived that.
brake.2: Everything still in place? I am.
brake.3: That is what I call braking with style.
brake.4: Phew. The brakes work, at least.
brake.5: Take a breath. We are doing fine.
brake.6: Someone did not expect us there, it seems.
brake.7: Good thing you are awake. I held my breath for a second.

talk.usual_early: Out early to {{name}} again, impressive. Have a good drive!
talk.usual_offer_early: Out early to {{name}} again, impressive. Shall I start the route?
